resources.string: 120 edges are reference-based reconstructions, not film scans. Five nominal apertures share one continuous strip per stock. Typography, spacing, phase and color are not fully calibrated. Some stocks have only partial numbering evidence; unknown markings are omitted. Portra 800 depicts the documented 800-2 batch; Pro 400H is historical. No perforations or light leaks are added. This choice changes output cropping and borders only, not grain or optical film-width parameters.
